cars.specification_market: Museum-listed 1963 Apollo 5000 GT coupe, selected as a documented restored reference for the original Apollo 3500/5000 and Vetta Ventura road family. Six equipment attributes follow the collection account only. Red body refurbishment and engine rebuild mean these are not universal factory-original specifications. No exact displacement conversion, power, torque, engine casting, original fitment, brake type, top speed or acceleration inferred. Buckley drives a different 3500 Spider; its specifications and impressions are not transferred to this 5000 coupe. Photo is a separately labelled 1965 5000 coupe, representative of body and family only. One conservative family admission; no separate engines, road bodies, renamed producers, GT.L 2+2 prototype, mid-engine proposal or dedicated racer. Unrelated modern Gumpert Apollo and later Griffith/Italia are separate programmes.
cars.summary: The Apollo GT earns a place as a distinctive American-Italian sporting GT: Milt Brown paired Buick power with bespoke Intermeccanica coachwork shaped by Ron Plescia and Franco Scaglione. Buckley’s original drive and founder interview document a coherent sporting design rather than a rarity-only curiosity. Count the Apollo 3500/5000 and Vetta Ventura production-road family once.
